items.source: The root path to be prepended to all request mappings configured on handler methods.
items.translation: 配置在处理方法上的所有请求映射将附加此根路径。

items.source:
Annotation to declare a controller that declares request mappings to be augmented with a base URI in the Spring Data
REST configuration.
items.translation: 用于声明控制器的注解，该控制器在 Spring Data REST 配置中声明的请求映射将附加一个基础 URI。
奥利弗·吉尔克，伊夫·加朗特
